Definition: from G5495 and a reduplicated form of G71; a hand-leader, i.e. personal conductor (of a blind person):--some to lead by the hand.
BiblicalUsage: One who leads by the hand is what Elymas becomes when the hand of the Lord blinds him on Cyprus: he goes about seeking someone to lead him by the hand. The sorcerer who would lead others astray must be led himself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God turns the tables on Elymas: the man who blinded others with sorcery is blinded and must be led by the hand.
